name: pt9-tech-follow-unaffordable
description: Playtest 9 pbd539 (014): a Technology follower 1 resource short got the technology and 'Pay all you have (1 resources short)' finished the bill. The technology is granted before its payment, so (bot pt9-followups, StrategyCardResolveKind.researchUnaffordable): the research press is refused when ready planets + trade goods + commodities cannot cover it (4 for the secondary, 6 for the holder's second); the web pays a Technology research in full. Base: tech-secondary-pay (pbd101 r1, Naalu played Technology); Mentak's planets are exhausted and its trade goods / commodities set to 0.
